name: dcbot
description: Discord bot with moderation, utility, economy, music, ticketing, and auto-reconnect support.

scripts.stop: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pidFile='.bot.pid'; if(!fs.existsSync(pidFile)){ console.log('No PID file found. Bot may not be running.'); process.exit(0);} const pid=fs.readFileSync(pidFile,'utf8').trim(); if(!pid || !/^[0-9]+$/.test(pid)){ fs.unlinkSync(pidFile); console.log('Removed invalid PID file.'); process.exit(0);} try { process.kill(Number(pid), 0); } catch (error) { if(error.code==='ESRCH'){ fs.unlinkSync(pidFile); console.log('Stale PID file removed. Bot is not running.'); process.exit(0);} if(error.code==='EPERM'){ console.log('PID exists but cannot be signaled.'); process.exit(1);} throw error; } try { process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGTERM'); console.log('Sent SIGTERM to bot PID', pid); } catch (error) { if(error.code==='ESRCH'){ fs.unlinkSync(pidFile); console.log('Stale PID file removed. Bot is not running.'); process.exit(0);} throw error; } process.exit(0); "
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
